text:
Type: gateleg dining table with drop leaves
Use: dining, flexible seating for guests; dining room, kitchen, small apartments
Style: farmhouse, traditional, rustic
Materials: solid pine top in a light antique stain, painted solid wood base
Colors: honey pine, light warm grey base
Shape: long oval top from two folding half-round leaves, small central drawer with knob, swing-out gate legs with stretchers, light and open
Feel: homey, warm, cottage, flexible
Goes with: grey or cream painted chairs, natural wood, white walls; farmhouse kitchens and country dining rooms

product.name: GAMLEBY
product.description: Its quick and easy to change the size of the table to suit your different needs. It extends to seat from 2 to 6 people.
